description: Curated per-citation decisions for exam reference-answer citations whose guide block id cannot be migrated automatically. action=remap sets newBlockIds (ids in the current guideContent); action=remove drops that block id, and a citation left without blocks is dropped while the question's other citations are kept. Read by scripts/guide_block_id_migrations.py at export; never rewritten by build_guide_block_id_migrations.py. Entries with method=manual are the 2026-11-01 per-citation review of the 132 citations the rebuild could not migrate by identical text (84 unresolved, 47 auto-adopted candidates, 1 earlier override); reason holds the reviewer note, newBlockIds were re-resolved by exact text against the final published content. reviewedBlockIds are the ids the reviewer chose in the pre-finalize rebuild content (the ids the reason text cites); the finalize step (cross-page mirror merges) renumbered some nodes, so newBlockIds may differ while naming the same text. Entries with reviewStatus b5-shift-reviewed / b5-trailing-heading are the 2026-11-02 batch-5 per-citation review of heuristic shift suspects and citations ending on a heading: each decision names the block(s) that carry the why_relevant content (keep / remap / trim trailing heading).
